SOW.TraitDescriptionFinale: An action with this trait is a spectacular culmination of your rhythmic momentum. You can use a finale only once per turn, and only if you have at least 1 Combo Chain. Upon declaring the action, you must spend all your current Combo Chains (resetting your total to 0). The power of the finale grows based on the number of chains spent, cumulatively scaling its baseline effects and unlocking devastating new capabilities as your momentum reaches higher thresholds.
SOW.TraitDescriptionUpbeat: An ability with this trait allows you to build momentum outside your standard rhythm. You can gain a Combo Chain from an upbeat ability only once per round, and it cannot cause you to exceed your maximum capacity of Combo Chains. However, this trait bypasses normal generation limits: you can gain an upbeat chain even if you have already gained your standard Combo Chain for the turn, or if another effect normally prevents you from gaining chains.
SOW.TraitDescriptionVirtuoso: This indicates abilities from the virtuoso class.
SOW.TraitDescriptionAcousticWind: Weapons and shields with this trait are masterfully crafted to double as musical instruments. Every acoustic item specifies its instrument category: Percussion, String, or Wind. You can use an acoustic item as a handheld musical instrument. If a feature or ability requires you to hold a musical instrument, wielding an acoustic item in the required number of hands satisfies this requirement. If a shield with the acoustic trait has an attached weapon, that weapon also gains the same acoustic trait as the shield.
